notes.title: Lost Technology - Chronicle Scenarios Added + Bugfix Update
notes.notes:
Dear Lost Technology fans,
Today, we've updated the game to add certain Chronicle scenarios to the English version!
We plan to continue adding Chronicle scenarios periodically, so please look forward to it.

Patch Notes

Added Chronicle scenarios to the Select Scenario menu.
You can select the Chronicle scenarios at the bottom of the faction selection screen.
If you only want to play the new Chronicle scenarios, there is no need to use the beta version.
Note: Save data is shared between the default and beta branches.
Fixed an issue where the screen would unexpectedly fade to black.


The Chronicle scenarios were translated by passionate fans.
Thank you very much for your hard work.

We hope you will continue to enjoy Lost Chronicles!

We plan to continue adding Chronicle scenarios periodically, so please look forward to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/49501c0f45cd455da4b41dc71cf81c899396be57.png

This feature updates the base executable file, so it's only available in beta in case any unexpected issues arise.

You can select the Chronicle scenarios at the bottom of the faction selection screen.


New Features in Beta

Added a text log feature.
Combined the controls for both targeting and un-targeting attack targets to the left double click.

We have also released an English translation of the spinoff novel written by CB-SXF6, the developer of the game!
Here, you can read the story of the last emperor of the Reinhardt Empire, Agnes, and her personal knight, Diethardt.
https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/120613/the-selfish-princess-and-her-even-more-selfish

https://x.com/CBSXF6_E

The Chronicle scenarios and spinoff novels were translated by passionate fans.

notes.title: UPDATE: English Localization Project and Donation DLC
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting Lost Technology.

PLAYISM has been working on the localization of this title, however due to the sheer volume of text, it's taking a lot of time and resources to get it done.

Therefore, we've decided to make this donation DLC available in order to ask for further support from Lost Technology fans and players who want to play the rest of the factions.

The Donation Soundtrack DLC is priced at $9.99, and it contains three unused/remixed tracks by composer Cranky.

Lost Technology - Donation Soundtrack Store page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1172490/Lost_Technology__Donation_Soundtrack/

Additionally, PLAYISM has completed the localization of the Apoitakara faction - the realm of the Dwarven blacksmiths. The game will be updated with this faction simulatenously with with the release of the Donation Soundtrack DLC.

The Story of Apoitakara
The kingdom of dwarves has their castle carved into Mt. Arsia, where they mine Orichalcum.
The best oresmith in Apoitakara is given the title of "Master", which comes with ultimate authority.
The current Master, Chromium, boasts of making the absolute finest weapons known, and often tests them out in battle himself.

Apoitakara Army
Dwarves are tough and strong fighters, but are slow in movement, and therefore particularly susceptible to attacks from elves and frogs.
Try using the boulders to your advantage to prevent enemy attacks while moving in on your opponents.

Also, the goal for this faction is to defeat the empire - however, jumping straight into this fight is tantamount to suicide. Better go around to all the other various areas first to bulk up your army.

Difficulty: Medium
Initial Income: 1000
Initial Funds: 10,000
Initial Units: 24
Unit Type: Soldier, Mage

Main Characters

Chromium  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30007316/f71038fb1627ca4570ee7baf39234851e08f3441.png

notes.title: Lost Technology Faction Update and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Lost Technology has been updated! 

Today we have added three new factions into the game, Kingdom of Gug, Castus and Dragon Knights of Fevnr. Please check out our previous posts for their full introductions. 

You may not know this, but the Kingdom of Gug scenario was actually written by Hato Moa, creator of Hatoful Boyfriend.
Following in the footsteps of Hatoful Boyfriend, the Lost Technology Kingdom of Gug scenario has also been released on Steam, so Hato provided us with a commemorative comment!

“Congratulations on Lost Technology and the English release of the Kingdom of Gug scenario!
It’s really deeply moving to think that those funky frogs are setting off out into the world.
Since it is, after all, a music-themed scenario, please be sure to check out the awesome original songs, too. 
Have fun!”
-Hato Moa


As well as adding the new factions into the game, we have also addressed a series of bug reports and fixes. 

Lost Technology 4/25 Updates: 
Added the Dragon Knights of Fevnir scenario
Added the Kingdom of Gug scenario
Added the Castus
Fixed a bug in Dungeon Mode where glitched units would appear on floor 49
Fixed a bug where the sprites associated with Electric Mages recruited by Ricard didn't load correctly
Fixed a bug where Japanese text would appear for machine gun class skills
Fixed a bug where Japanese text would appear for 'Bite II' and 'Bite III' skills
Fixed a bug where Japanese text would appear for certain enhance skills, such as 'Move UP,' 'MP Recovery UP,' and 'Targe'
Fixed a bug where certain dungeon names would appear in Japanese
Fixed a bug where certain Guardian names appeared in Japanese
Fixed a bug where hovering over the semi-auto unit control panel displayed garbled text
Added additional background art so scenario cutscenes take place in more varied locales

For this update, the game has increased in price from $2.99 to $4.99.
Everyone who already owns the game, will get the update for free.

We hope that you enjoy the game and the new factions! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

notes.title: Update 11/2 - New Scenarios
notes.notes:
Hi All

We have some very exciting updates for you all today! 

11/2 Updates:
Game optimization
Text fix
Class name fix
Added new modes;Free Mode / Random Scenario /  Dungeon Master


We have added three new modes to the game, allowing you to try out a variety of different scenarios!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007316/93d50d0599ced198fdcf09c62e3372d032336075.jpg


Free Mode
Simple Simulation Game
Same time frame as the main story.
Even if your main base falls, the game will continue.
Special defense units will appear when attacking castles.
There are no story events.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007316/683835aa6191010dfc1eb8464295279d40811568.jpg


Random Scenario
A scenario with a random position and faction.
Choose the position of the controlled unit.
Set the number of factions.
Set the unit's starting level.
Set the unit's training level.
Decide if this unit is a defense unit or not.
There will be no story events.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007316/653c677d4812fc687ce4e6ac572cd3be3fc15dc4.jpg


Dungeon Master
Clear dungeons in this hack-and-slash-type scenario.
The dungeons are located in the Snow Plains of Nilus. Use "Find" to access.
After clearing a floor, a random unit will be added to the group.
Enemies defeated while wandering through the dungeon have a set chance of dropping items.
Every 10 floors, a boss will appear.
There are no story events.
Level up your squad and aim to clear all 100 floors!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30007316/4564d449e99977df0c015083a09abefde2245ca6.jpg


We hope that you enjoy these new additions to the game! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

notes.title: Lost Technology Update - 21/08/2017
notes.notes:
Hi all

We have just updated Lost Technology with the following bug fixes and updates:

Added various resolution options.
1280x720, 1440x900, 1600x1200
[Resolution can also be changed manually by editing the numbers in the exe files]
Fixed bug where the game crashes in full-screen mode when you press ESC.
Now, pressing ESC to return to the title screen, or at the title screen, gives you the option to close the game.
Fixed small issue where the snake unit could not be recruited.
Fixed bug where the game continued after beating the game with Alfheim.
Fixed Help for Crystal Guard that was appearing in Japanese.
Crime is now selectable from the beginning (no story).
[Certain conditions must be met to unlock in the Japanese version.]
Fixed bug where Clifford couldn't hire any units.
Fixed bug where Frog Attack II was an unusable skill.
Fixed the help text of the skill Poison Foe.
Fixed the single character mode. Now the game can finish properly.
Changed the priority of the skills Heal and Cure.
Fixed the single character mode that Crime become hostile upon invading into their territory.


We hope you keep enjoying the game. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

notes.title: Lost Technology Release Date - August 9th!
notes.notes:
Lost Technology will be releasing August 9th! 

Set in a world where advanced technology has been lost due to a constant war between the 12 different factions. Choose your side, and fight on for justice, peace or personal desires to conquer and unite the continent under your rule. This country-oriented strategy RTS is coming soon! 

Add it to your wishlist now to be notified upon its release! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/420520/Lost_Technology/

Important Information
This is a game has a large amount of story text for each playable faction. Ideally we would like to provide fully localized versions for each respective faction, however, the size and scale of the game meant that a full localization would be extremely difficult to provide all at once, and so only the three factions known as the Reinald Empire, Makan, and Álfheim are included in the English release.

It is possible to start with any of the other playable factions, but story events will not occur and only the simulation part of the game may be played.

The Japanese version still contains the currently available free version, all of the basic functions without changes, and all factions are included in full right off the bat. However, it will be distributed as a paid title due to adjustments made specifically for Steam and the addition of trading cards, etc.

We currently plan to look carefully at how this title sells (including sales within Japan) and will proceed with the localization of the remaining factions in accordance with the sales numbers. The remaining factions are set to be distributed as additional DLC in the future. Please stay tuned for more news regarding further details.
